items.title: Stremio Origin 1.1.1 inside
items.text: Live TV, chapters and skips, seek previews, film collections, Trakt and every other improvement of the original app.

items.title: Films and Series tabs, and a Top 10
items.text: Each with its categories: today's Top 10, popular, top rated, this year's, last year's and every genre.

items.title: An Anime tab
items.text: The anime catalogs of your addons, on a tab of their own.

items.title: Opened from FreeTV
items.text: A film or series picked on FreeTV's home opens here, on its own page.

items.title: The pointer when you want it
items.text: Move the remote, turn or press the wheel and it comes out. It stays until you press Back.

items.title: Seek previews
items.text: A picture of the film on the seek bar, for debrid and direct links.

items.title: Subtitles your way
items.text: Font, size, colour, background, brightness and position, changed while you watch.

items.title: Tracks per show
items.text: The subtitles and audio you pick stay for the whole show.

items.title: Chapters and skips
items.text: Chapters on the seek bar, and Skip intro and recap by itself or on OK.

items.title: Live TV
items.text: Channels and sports from your live addons, with Favorites and Recent.

items.title: Film collections
items.text: On the title page and in the Library, and the next film after the credits.

items.title: 28 languages
items.text: Greek, Brazilian Portuguese, Romanian and Hungarian among them.
